Klean by Geerho Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 18, 2026. Version 1.4.

Geerho Tech LLC, which owns and operates Klean by Geerho ("Klean", "we"), is the personal information controller for the Klean apps and web app. Laundromat businesses on Klean ("Operators") also receive limited customer information, as described below, and act as controllers for their own use of it.

Data Protection Officer: Tracy Jon Miranda, for Geerho Tech LLC · info@klean.ph · (619) 796-1115 · 2108 N St, Ste N, Sacramento, CA 95816, USA

1. What we collect

CategoryWhatSource
AccountDisplay name, email (as verified by your sign-in provider), profile photo, member code, sign-in provider identifiers; your mobile number if you choose to save itYou; Apple/Google/GitHub
Identity verificationCollected by Didit, not by us: ID document images, a live selfie and the biometric face template derived from it. What we keep: verification status; your verified legal name and the issuing country of your ID; and keyed one-way hashes of your document details and of your name + date of birth, used only to detect duplicate accounts. We do not store your ID number, ID images or selfie.You, via Didit
PaymentsPayment amount, currency, method type (e.g. "GCash", "card"), payment status, provider references. We never receive full card numbers or e-wallet credentials.PayMongo, Stripe
In-app purchasesFor the verification fee bought in the app: the store transaction ID, product, price, currency and date. Apple or Google handle the payment itself; we don't receive your payment details.Apple (App Store), Google (Play)
Laundry activityMachines scanned, orders, loads, weight at intake, cycle start/finish times, points earned and redeemed, branches visitedYour use of the Service
Staff and businessYour role, which branches you're assigned to, who hired you; for Operators, business details and payout account status. Each branch's name, address, map location, phone and email are public (shown to customers).You; Operators; Stripe/PayMongo
Location (optional)If you allow it, your device's approximate location is sent to show laundromats nearest you. We don't store it. A laundromat's own location (set by its Super Admin) is public.Your device
TechnicalDevice type, app version, IP address, sign-in times, error logsYour device
Wallet card (optional)If you add your Klean card to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet, it holds your name, member code (as a QR), points and laundromat. Apple keeps it on your device (and in iCloud if you use it); for Google Wallet, Klean sends those details to Google, which stores the card in your Google account. Remove it in Wallet any time.You; Google
On your device onlyThe Home Screen widget's summary (points, paid loads, your laundromat) and the Lock Screen countdown are kept on your phone; reading an NFC sticker happens on your phone.Your device

2. Why we use it, and our legal basis

PurposeLegal basis
Create and run your account; process payments; activate machines; keep your wallet and pointsPerformance of our contract with you

3. Who sees your information

  • Operators where you do laundry see your display name, a masked email (e.g. j*@gmail.com), your points with them, your visits and spend with them, and the times you used their machines. They don't** see your ID, legal name, date of birth, or activity at other businesses.
  • Your employer (if you're staff) sees your display name, verified legal name and verification status, so they know who works for them.
  • Service providers acting on our instructions: Didit (identity verification), PayMongo and Stripe (payments; when you pay, we send them your verified name, your email and, if you saved one, your mobile number, so their payment page is filled in for you), Apple and Google (sign-in, in-app purchases, push notifications), GitHub (sign-in), and our hosting, database and messaging providers (Supabase, Google Firebase).
  • Authorities, when required by law or to protect rights and safety.
  • We don't sell personal information.

4. International transfers

Some providers (e.g. Stripe, Didit, cloud hosting) may process data outside your country. We use contractual and technical safeguards required by applicable law for these transfers. [List provider regions.]

5. How long we keep it

DataRetention
Account dataWhile your account exists; anonymized on deletion (a saved mobile number is deleted, and you can remove it any time in Account)
Transaction and tax recordsAs long as tax and accounting laws require, with personal identifiers removed after account deletion
Duplicate-detection hashesWhile your account exists; deleted when you delete your account, except for accounts suspended for fraud or abuse, where they're kept for 5 years to stop re-registration
ID images and selfiesHeld by Didit under its retention policy (see didit.me/privacy); never stored by Klean
Technical logs90 days

6. Your rights

Under the Data Privacy Act you have the right to be informed, to access, to object, to erasure or blocking, to rectification, to data portability, and to damages, and to file a complaint with the National Privacy Commission (privacy.gov.ph). If you're in the EU/UK or another jurisdiction with similar laws, you have the equivalent rights there. You can:

  • see and correct most information in the app;
  • delete your account in the app (Account → Delete account), which also revokes Sign in with Apple;
  • withdraw consent for biometric verification. Since verification is required to use Klean, this means closing your account;
  • contact our DPO at info@klean.ph for anything else.

We'll respond within the period required by law.

7. Security

Data is encrypted in transit; sensitive tokens are encrypted at rest; identity attributes are stored only as keyed hashes; access by staff and Operators is limited by role and branch. No system is perfectly secure; we'll notify you and the NPC of personal data breaches as required by law.

8. Children

Klean isn't intended for anyone under 18, and we don't knowingly collect their information.

9. Changes

We'll notify you in the app before material changes take effect.
